| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | `string` | no | Only this model. |

| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1–500 (default 100). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Cursor: the last row's `id` from the previous page. |

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_cost_override`. One of `model_cost_override`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The model cost override's id. |

| `data.effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective from. |
| `data.effective_to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective to. |
| `data.note` | `string` | A note about the model cost override. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the model cost override was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.deleted` | `boolean` | Present and true on a delete response. |
